description:
Activate Halsin by paying {1}, causing a Treasure token to become a 4/4 Bear creature token in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Treasure Bear.
Activate the Treasure Bear token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
The Treasure Bear dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.
